queries.name: recordsPrice
queries.sql:
WITH m AS (
	SELECT mark_price FROM perps.mark_prices WHERE market_id = $1
	ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC LIMIT 1
), i AS (
	SELECT index_price, block_time FROM (
		(SELECT block, tx_index, log_index, sub, index_price, block_time FROM perps.mark_prices WHERE market_id = $1
			ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC LIMIT 1)
		UNION ALL
		(SELECT block, tx_index, log_index, sub, index_price, block_time FROM perps.index_prices
			WHERE market_id = $1 AND kind = 'aggregate' AND index_price IS NOT NULL
			ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC LIMIT 1)
	) u ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT m.mark_price / $2::numeric, i.index_price / $2::numeric,
	round((m.mark_price - i.index_price) * 10000 / NULLIF(i.index_price, 0), 3), i.block_time
	FROM i LEFT JOIN m ON true

queries.name: recordsWindow
queries.sql:
SELECT (array_agg(f.price ORDER BY f.block, f.tx_index, f.log_index, f.sub))[1] / $3::numeric,
	max(f.price) / $3::numeric, min(f.price) / $3::numeric,
	COALESCE(sum(f.size_usd), 0) / $3::numeric,
	COALESCE(sum(f.size_usd) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM perps.liquidations l
	WHERE l.block = f.block AND l.tx_index = f.tx_index AND l.market_id = f.market_id AND l."user" = f.taker
		AND l.log_index > f.log_index
		AND f.taker_order_id = (SELECT g.taker_order_id FROM perps.fills g
			WHERE g.block = l.block AND g.tx_index = l.tx_index AND g.market_id = l.market_id AND g.taker = l."user"
				AND g.log_index < l.log_index
			ORDER BY g.log_index DESC, g.sub DESC LIMIT 1))), 0) / $3::numeric
	FROM perps.fills f WHERE f.market_id = $1 AND f.block_time >= $2

	FROM perps.fills f WHERE f.market_id = $1 AND f.block_time >= $2

	(SELECT short_oi / $2::numeric FROM perps.open_interest WHERE market_id = $1
		ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC LIMIT 1),
	fs.hourly, fs.funding_rate / $2::numeric
	FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT funding_rate, trim_scale(funding_rate * 0.000000000000000001)::text AS hourly
		FROM perps.funding_settlements WHERE market_id = $1
		ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC LIMIT 1) fs ON true

queries.name: recordsPrice
queries.sql:
WITH m AS (
	SELECT mark_price FROM perps.mark_prices WHERE market_id = $1
	ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC LIMIT 1
), i AS (
	SELECT index_price, block_time FROM (
		(SELECT block, tx_index, log_index, sub, index_price, block_time FROM perps.mark_prices WHERE market_id = $1
			ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC LIMIT 1)
		UNION ALL
		(SELECT block, tx_index, log_index, sub, index_price, block_time FROM perps.index_prices
			WHERE market_id = $1 AND kind = 'aggregate' AND index_price IS NOT NULL
			ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC LIMIT 1)
	) u ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT m.mark_price / $2::numeric, i.index_price / $2::numeric,
	round((m.mark_price - i.index_price) * 10000 / NULLIF(i.index_price, 0), 3), i.block_time
	FROM i LEFT JOIN m ON true

queries.name: recordsWindow
queries.sql:
SELECT (array_agg(f.price ORDER BY f.block, f.tx_index, f.log_index, f.sub))[1] / $3::numeric,
	max(f.price) / $3::numeric, min(f.price) / $3::numeric,
	COALESCE(sum(f.size_usd), 0) / $3::numeric,
	COALESCE(sum(f.size_usd) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM perps.liquidations l
	WHERE l.block = f.block AND l.tx_index = f.tx_index AND l.market_id = f.market_id AND l."user" = f.taker
		AND l.log_index > f.log_index
		AND f.taker_order_id = (SELECT g.taker_order_id FROM perps.fills g
			WHERE g.block = l.block AND g.tx_index = l.tx_index AND g.market_id = l.market_id AND g.taker = l."user"
				AND g.log_index < l.log_index
			ORDER BY g.log_index DESC, g.sub DESC LIMIT 1))), 0) / $3::numeric
	FROM perps.fills f WHERE f.market_id = $1 AND f.block_time >= $2

queries.name: baseline_tickers
queries.sql:
SELECT 'PERP_' || upper(m.symbol) || '_USDC', m.symbol, mp.mark_price / 1e18, mp.index_price / 1e18, NULL::float8,
    trim_scale((SELECT funding_rate FROM perps.funding_settlements x WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1) * 0.000000000000000001)::text, (SELECT funding_rate FROM perps.funding_settlements x WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1) / 1e18,
    NULL::float8, (s.open_interest_long + s.open_interest_short) / 1e18, h.open / 1e18, h.close / 1e18, h.high / 1e18,
    h.low / 1e18, h.amount / 1e18, h.volume
FROM perps.markets m
LEFT JOIN perps.market_stats_rolling s ON s.market_id = m.market_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.mark_price, x.index_price FROM perps.mark_prices x WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id
    ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1) mp ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (array_agg(price ORDER BY block, tx_index, log_index, sub))[1] AS open,
    (array_agg(price ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC, sub DESC))[1] AS close, max(price) AS high, min(price) AS low, sum(size_usd) AS amount,
    sum(size_usd / NULLIF(price, 0)) AS volume
    FROM perps.fills WHERE market_id = m.market_id AND block_time >= $1) h ON true
ORDER BY m.market_id

queries.name: baseline_changes
queries.sql:
SELECT 'PERP_' || upper(m.symbol) || '_USDC', m.symbol, l.index_price / 1e18, (SELECT (l.index_price - x.index_price) / NULLIF(x.index_price, 0) FROM perps.mark_prices x
        WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id AND x.block_time <= $1::timestamptz - interval '5 minutes'
        ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT (l.index_price - x.index_price) / NULLIF(x.index_price, 0) FROM perps.mark_prices x
        WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id AND x.block_time <= $1::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes'
        ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT (l.index_price - x.index_price) / NULLIF(x.index_price, 0) FROM perps.mark_prices x
        WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id AND x.block_time <= $1::timestamptz - interval '1 hour'
        ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT (l.index_price - x.index_price) / NULLIF(x.index_price, 0) FROM perps.mark_prices x
        WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id AND x.block_time <= $1::timestamptz - interval '4 hours'
        ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT (l.index_price - x.index_price) / NULLIF(x.index_price, 0) FROM perps.mark_prices x
        WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id AND x.block_time <= $1::timestamptz - interval '24 hours'
        ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT (l.index_price - x.index_price) / NULLIF(x.index_price, 0) FROM perps.mark_prices x
        WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id AND x.block_time <= $1::timestamptz - interval '3 days'
        ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT (l.index_price - x.index_price) / NULLIF(x.index_price, 0) FROM perps.mark_prices x
        WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id AND x.block_time <= $1::timestamptz - interval '7 days'
        ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT (l.index_price - x.index_price) / NULLIF(x.index_price, 0) FROM perps.mark_prices x
        WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id AND x.block_time <= $1::timestamptz - interval '30 days'
        ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1)
FROM perps.markets m
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.index_price FROM perps.mark_prices x WHERE x.market_id = m.market_id
    ORDER BY x.block DESC, x.tx_index DESC, x.log_index DESC, x.sub DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true
ORDER BY m.market_id
